operations.summary: Create a durable control upgrade rollout
operations.summary_zh: 创建主控升级发布任务
operations.description: Requires control.upgrades.manage in a platform scope. The canonical request freezes the sorted target cohort, canary subset, batch size, and mandatory automatic rollback. The request validates the input and the current target cohort, records the create intent and returns 202 with its preparation; License issuance and the download and verification of the forward and rollback artifacts run in the background, and the plan (state queued) exists once the preparation is ready. A failed preparation keeps a stable failure_code; it is retried by a new create. A replay rechecks live RBAC and returns the same preparation without another license call, download, or plan. A changed request under the same idempotency key returns 409.

fields.name: node_ids
fields.description: Canonical lowercase UUIDs in strictly increasing byte order.

fields.name: canary_node_ids
fields.description: One or two strictly sorted canonical UUIDs, each also present in node_ids.

fields.name: start_when_ready
fields.description: Start the plan once its preparation made it, as the creator's start with reason operator_upgrade (the console's create-then-start). Omitted when not wanted; the approval center's control.upgrade rule leaves the plan queued with start_failure_code approval_required.
